# Yohaku Companion v1.9.0

## Highlights

- The application is now signed with a Developer ID certificate and notarized by Apple. First launch no longer requires a Gatekeeper override, and the signing identity is stable across every future update.
- Integration credentials move from the protected local credential journal into the system Keychain automatically on first launch. Nothing needs to be re-entered.

## Update notes

- **Accessibility permission must be granted again after updating from v1.8.6 or earlier.** Previous builds were ad-hoc signed, and macOS ties Accessibility approval to a code signature identity. The change of identity invalidates the earlier approval. Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility** and enable Yohaku Companion once. This is required only for this update; subsequent updates preserve the permission.
- Accessibility remains optional. It is required only for window-title capture; application identity and media synchronization work without it.
- Pairing, Live Desk consent, and Bridge configuration are unaffected. No re-pairing is required.
